title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Crowe leads Austin Championship
items.text: Trace Crowe secured the Austin Championship presented by Compliance Solutions title with a 14-under total, finishing one stroke ahead of Chad Ramey, Sami Valimaki, and Erik van Rooyen, closing with a 1-under 71 at Omni Barton Creek’s Fazio Canyons Course in Austin, Texas.

items.headline: McIlroy ties Race to Dubai record
items.text: Rory McIlroy clinched his eighth DP World Tour Race to Dubai title, matching Colin Montgomerie's all-time record by finishing runner-up to Tyrrell Hatton at the DP World Tour Championship and holding off Eugenio Chacarra in the season-long points race.
